title: Matrix unit-minor normalization over a local ring assuming localized modules are free.
statement: Given finite free scalar extensions over a local ring and a map whose residue has one-dimensional kernel, the map is equivalent by source and target linear equivalences to (u,a) ↦ (u,g(a)) with a free complementary target module C.

proof.text: Choose finite free coordinates and an invertible leading pivot B using new-residue-kernel-unit-minor-pivot. The remaining three blocks are arbitrary.

Write the coordinate map as F(u,a)=(B(u)+b(a),c(u)+d(a)). Construct the source automorphism sX(u,a)=(B(u)+b(a),a), whose inverse is (B inverse(u-b(a)),a), and the target automorphism sY(y,z)=(y,z-c(B inverse(y))), whose inverse changes the subtraction to addition. The explicit formulas prove linearity and the inverse identities.

Define g=d-c composed with B inverse composed with b. Expand F and cancel c(u) to obtain sY(F(u,a))=((sX(u,a)).1,g((sX(u,a)).2)). Compose the old coordinate equivalences with sX and sY. Retain the free complementary module C from the pivot statement.
